entities.summary: Vitaly Shulakov is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for Olimp Riga in the Latvian Hockey League (LHL). He last played in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL) with the now VHL club, HC Yugra. He first played in the top Russian tier with Amur Khabarovsk in 2004.
